title: Standing trading authorization: arming a strategy is the owner's standing click
lifecycle_note: Merged 2026-11-17 by the owner's click, with amendments 1 (AUTO, a risk-reducing Position Manager) and 2 (Council auto-arm); amendment 3 (account risk profiles) 2026-11-18. Nothing is built on the platform side; xauusd's RFC_STRATEGY_RECOMMENDATION and profile RFC implement it.

phases.title: The decision recorded; the vision core's trading line amended

evidence.quote: given per action or as a standing arm of one strategy

phases.note: a documented decision, not a build: this ADR changes no platform code

phases.title: Amendment 1 recorded: AUTO under Omega's live arm when nothing is armed; the Position Manager only reduces risk

of.quote: as Omega's live arm for AUTO selection of the single best strategy

phases.note: proven once a strategy_arm.v1 report shows mode auto (AUTO running with nothing armed); until then, the documented decision

phases.title: Amendment 2 recorded: while the owner's Council auto-arm is on, the council arms and disarms within its gates

evidence.quote: while the owner's Council auto-arm is on, by the council within its gates

phases.note: a documented decision, not a build

phases.title: Amendment 3 recorded: an autonomous profile upgrade only up to the owner's ceiling, never mid-trade

evidence.quote: The highest profile the agent may reach is set only by the owner

phases.note: a documented decision, not a build: xauusd builds the profiles and the profile agent

phases.title: Arm and disarm in Nexus: cap of 3, auto-disarm, Decision Engine veto
phases.note: proven by a strategy_arm.v1 report that mirrors an owner's arm or disarm click in Nexus

phases.title: Arm and disarm mirrored as strategy_arm.v1 xauusd_digest reports
phases.note: proven by any strategy_arm.v1 report of xauusd-risk-manager in agent_reports
